name: SetActiveExcelWorksheetNode
label: Set Active Excel Worksheet
description: Sets the active (selected) worksheet in an Excel workbook by name or index.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook in which to set the active worksheet.

fields.name: SelectionType
fields.label: Selection Type
fields.description: Specifies how to identify the worksheet: by Name or by Index.

fields.name: SearchValue
fields.label: Search Value
fields.description: The worksheet name (if selection type is 'Name') or 1-based index (if selection type is 'Index').
